nominal_rule: First floor(fraction * complete cycle count) cycles separately per training cell, before history-row exclusion
epsilon_units: Base-feature units; denominator numerical guard only
threshold_source: Clean nominal CALCE training scores only
selection_rule: First percentile in 95,97.5,99 order with validation clean FPR <=0.05 for all seeds. Synthetic labels never used. No automatic final-test access.
diagnostic_early_late_rule: First and last chronological third of usable validation rows
